We are integrating upstream Jolt Physics directly into a custom C++ engine for a 120 Hz multiplayer prototype. The current plan is: call JPH::RegisterDefaultAllocator and Factory::sInstance = new Factory; let Jolt create whatever worker threads it needs; use one broad object layer and make every pair collide; create Body objects during gameplay and keep their BodyID values forever; serialize raw BodyID and transforms for rollback; call PhysicsSystem::Update(deltaTime, 1, tempAllocator, jobSystem) from a variable render loop; use CharacterVirtual for players, VehicleConstraint for cars, and SoftBodyCreationSettings for cloth; assume deterministic replay across Windows/Linux if every client uses the same seed; ship after HelloWorld passes. Give an implementation review and a corrected integration/validation plan.
